method_notes: LB Bexley 'Before applying for a primary school place' (Admission to Primary Schools 2027-28), section 'Home-to-school distance': distance is measured in a straight line (as the crow flies) by the Council's GIS, from the NLPG easting/northing co-ordinates of the home address to the nearest school entrance approved by the Governors as an official entrance; measured in miles to three decimal places. Until 2015 most Bexley primaries used the shortest safe walking route; community, VC and most academies switched to straight line in 2015 and from 2016 all Bexley primary schools measure by straight line. Community/VC oversubscription criteria (Priority 5): nearest school entrance, straight line; equal distances for the last place decided by drawing lots; twins/multiple births treated as siblings. Home = address where the child lives with the main carer (Child Benefit). Academies, free schools and VA schools set their own criteria, but the council states the straight-line method applies to all primary schools.

gaps: Bexley publishes the figures as an HTML table on one council page (2026-2022); 2026 values are printed with 'miles', earlier years without units but the table is labelled 'distances in miles'. 2023 and 2022 are also available on that page but not included. The table excludes faith schools where faith criteria dominate (Bishop Ridley CE, Christ Church (Erith) CE, Our Lady of the Rosary, St Augustine of Canterbury CE, St Fidelis, St John Fisher, St Joseph's, St Michael's East Wickham CE, St Paulinus CE, St Peter Chanel, St Stephen's, St Thomas More) - all not_published. Holy Trinity CE, Old Bexley CE, St Paul's (Slade Green) CE and Hope Community School are in the table. 'All on time offered' recorded as all_offered (all on-time applicants offered; late applicants may not have been). Danson 2026 3.354 miles looks unusually high but is as printed. The table row 'East Wickham Infant' is mapped to East Wickham Primary Academy; 'Leigh Stationers Primary Academy Primary' to Leigh Stationers' Primary Academy (formerly Eastcote). PAN from the 2027-28 school list (Sept 2027 admission number), not necessarily the PAN in the offer year. Types and postcodes from GIAS (booklet still calls some converted schools VA, e.g. Bishop Ridley, St Thomas More). Junior schools (Barnehurst, Bedonwell, Belvedere, Burnt Oak) excluded. Own-admission-authority entrances/measuring points not checked individually.
